notes: BASE only: no separate fan pressure curves, leakage, or blade swirl.
Input/output area 0.0016 m2. Prescribed inlet velocity, pressure outlet.
Each combination needs measured or explicitly assumed equivalent velocity. No PWM averaging.
Identical equivalent velocities produce identical boundary conditions; distinct labels are not independent fan physics.
Identical exchanged pairs are intentionally retained for experiment ID matching; not independent physical conditions.
Archived equal-stage cases are not included. The shared production queue uses three mixed representative conditions.

equivalent_flow_assumption.basis: Constructed symmetric pressure-addition proxy with common quadratic resistance; division by two preserves the previous equal-stage anchor speeds.
limitations: No physical fan operating point is solved.
Swapped pairs have identical boundary conditions: nine labels, six distinct flows.
No claim of actual pressure, energy use, or experimental recovery ranking.
equivalent_flow_assumption.reference_scope: Fan laws motivate squared pressure contribution; the normalized formula here is an unvalidated project assumption, not an AMCA prediction of these installed fans.
